Definition: from the same as G716; an articulation (of the body):--joint.
BiblicalUsage: Harmos is a joint, the place where bone meets bone, and it appears once, in the sharpest verse in the Bible. In Hebrews 4:12 the word of God is sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse means the word gets into places I cannot reach myself: it finds the joint and the marrow, and it tells the truth about what is hiding there.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
